 Pivot longer

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)
library(labelled)

C4_E2 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_C4_E2_pour_long.csv", show_col_types = F)
```

# Pivot longer
```{r}

vars_num <- C4_E2 %>% 
  select(starts_with("fa_cpl")) %>%
  select(-where(is.character)) %>% 
  colnames()

C4_E3 <- C4_E2 %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = all_of(vars_num),
      .fns = ~ if_else(.x == -7, NA_integer_, .x)
    )
  )

vars_to_pivot <- C4_E3 %>% 
  select(starts_with("fa_cpl")) %>% 
  colnames()

couple0_long <- C4_E3 %>%  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(vars_to_pivot),
    names_to = c("rang_cpl", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "fa_cpl(.)_(\\w+)",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )


```


```{r}
write_csv(couple0_long, "data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_couple0_long.csv")
```


```{r}
couple0_long <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_couple0_long.csv", show_col_types = F)
```

# Renommer variables

```{r}

vars_module <- couple0_long %>% 
  select(conjt_prenom:union_enf) %>% 
  colnames()

couple1_long <- couple0_long %>% 
  rename_with( ~ paste0("fa_cpl_", .x), all_of(vars_module)) %>% 
  rename("fa_cp_rang" = "rang_cpl")

rm(vars_module)

```

# Recoder NAs pour Stata

```{r}

source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/rcd_tagged_na_1rep.R")
source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/lbl_levels_na.R")
library(labelled)

vars_1rep <- couple1_long %>% 
  select(where(is.double)) %>% 
  select(-fa_cp_date_creation) %>% 
  colnames()

# Les deux fonctions fonctionnent!

couple2_long <- couple1_long %>%
  rcd_tagged_na_1rep(all_of(vars_1rep)) %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_1rep), lbl_levels_na))

table(as_factor(couple2_long$fa_cpl_union_enf), useNA = "ifany")

rm(list = c("vars_1rep", "lbl_levels_na", "rcd_tagged_na_1rep"))



```
